task_title: start advertises dashboard that --no-dashboard never serves (DF-SPECLANG-3-R5)
task_criteria: node bin/speclang start --no-dashboard --port 3199 prints no Dashboard URL; worker commit f0e3aff8 merged to main; build + full suite green

items.criterion: node bin/speclang start --no-dashboard --port 3199 prints no Dashboard URL; worker commit f0e3aff8 merged to main; build + full suite green
items.detail: (1) Banner: bin/speclang:66-72 gates the URL on `options.dashboard !== false` and prints `Dashboard: disabled (--no-dashboard)` otherwise. Live run `node bin/speclang start --no-dashboard --port 3199` printed `Dashboard: disabled (--no-dashboard)`; `grep -c "Dashboard: http" /tmp/df3b.out` -> `0`; TCP probe of 127.0.0.1:3199 -> `PORT 3199 NOT LISTENING`. The daemon's own URL print at dist/src/daemon/index.js:141 is inside `if (dashboard)` (src/daemon/index.ts:84), so it is correctly suppressed. (2) Merge: `git merge-base --is-ancestor f0e3aff8 main` -> `YES f0e3aff8 is ancestor of main`; `git branch --contains f0e3aff8` lists `main`; `git diff f0e3aff8 HEAD -- bin/speclang` is empty (merge 1e5a9aa4 carries the worker commit unchanged). (3) Build: `npm run build` (tsc) exit_code 0. Full suite: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` exit_code 0 -> `Test Files  102 passed | 4 skipped (106)` / `Tests  1850 passed | 58 skipped (1908)`. New regression test `npx vitest run tests/cli/start-dashboard-contract.test.ts` -> `Tests  2 passed (2)`, covering both the no-flag (URL printed + port really listens) and --no-dashboard (no URL, no listener) directions.
